purpose: Close V2.8.12 development while preserving blind prospective E-event accumulation, downstream human-decision safeguards, and all research/governance locks until the frozen information gate is satisfied.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not inspect D5/D10, benchmark return, excess return, IC, win rate or p-values before the V2.8.13 contract is frozen and authorized.
Do not widen V2.8.11 historical windows or reopen full historical E backfill to accelerate the readiness count.
Do not relax E classifier, materiality, triage, identity, diversity or concentration rules to increase event yield.
Do not hand-promote the genesis shadow event or any future E positive into a real candidate packet without a separately validated strategy and discipline plan.
Do not introduce AUTO_BUY, AUTO_SELL, AUTO_REBALANCE, order submission or brokerage execution paths.
terminal_current_state: V2.8.12 is sealed for development and remains in automated blind prospective accumulation. The system should collect rather than invent new research structure until an allowed transition condition is actually satisfied.
